name: web-indigo-to-navy-blurred-gradient-background
title: Periwinkle to Navy Blurred Gradient
whatItIs: A wide image of a soft blurred gradient from bright periwinkle at the top through deep indigo to near-black navy at the bottom, with a faint dashed arc at the right.
whatItMeans: A smooth light-to-dark fall feels like dusk and gives depth for text or dividers.
techniques: Blur two hues into a single smooth transition
Fade from light to very dark toward the bottom
Keep a faint dashed line as a subtle detail
Use it as a footer or section transition
bestFor: Colour references for dark-mode tech brands

vocabulary.definition: A smooth colour blend with no visible shapes.
A transition from light to dark like fading daylight.
A gradient strip linking two sections.
